name: Sebastian Griffin
source:
The grandson of the scientist who invented the invisibility formula, his exposure to it has long made his condition permanent -- though he's otherwise human, he's considered a monster for all means and purposes.

Sebastian craves attention almost as much as he enjoys authority. Despite this, he actually has a lot of insecurities and uses his obnoxious personality to hide them.

[From [url=http://monstrousloversevn.tumblr.com/characters]official site[/url]]
